title: Strategies — the roster and what each one governs

components.purpose: Show every strategy the user can reach and, for each, how many agents it currently governs.
components.current_implementation: Unstyled ul of bordered li. Tailwind class names are present but Tailwind is not installed, so nothing renders styled. NOTE: there is no `empty` branch — when `listings` is [] the component renders an empty <ul> and the page shows only its heading and intro paragraph. Listed as a state because it plainly exists; filed as `strategy-list-has-no-empty-state`. | strategy-row: Bordered li; name and a scope/revision caption on one baseline row, optional tagline, then the governs line. No truncation handling for long names or taglines. | fork-capacity-notice: role=status bordered paragraph above the list.
constraints: The bound-agent count ('governs') must stay visible on the roster row itself, not behind a hover or a detail click — a strategy is never an isolated object here, and the count belongs where the user first meets it rather than only in the confirmation, by which point they have already decided
`unreadable` must keep saying that the strategies are not gone, only unreachable — the distinction between 'you have none' and 'we could not ask' must survive any redesign
Rows with boundAgentCount > 0 are currently emphasised relative to zero-bound rows; that difference must remain perceivable without relying on font-weight alone

[strategy-row] 'BattleGrid' vs 'Yours' (scope) must remain distinguishable at a glance — it decides whether the row offers Edit or Fork, and a user who misreads it will try an action the platform refuses
[strategy-row] Revision number must stay attached to the strategy it belongs to; it is the identity users track across edits
[strategy-row] Long names and taglines must not push the actions out of reach — currently untested and unhandled
[fork-capacity-notice] Must stay non-blocking — it explains a limit, it does not stop the user browsing or editing what they already have
[fork-capacity-notice] Announced via role=status; it appears without a user action and must not steal focus

components.purpose: Turn away a request that has no authority, and say how to fix it.
components.current_implementation: Shared component rendered in place of the page body.
constraints: Every cause — no session, forged cookie, unknown user, revoked connection, unrefreshable token, 401 from BattleGrid — arrives here and must keep producing one page. They differ in cause and not in remedy, and splitting them visually would imply actions the user does not have (design W-C)
Must not imply the user's data is lost

flows.name: Fork a platform strategy to edit it
steps: Make my own copy to edit

accessibility.notes: Per-row nav is labelled `Actions for <strategy name>`. Load failure is role=alert; fork capacity is role=status. No live region for the list itself — it is server-rendered and does not update in place.
